governance_bootstrap.summary: Completion requires exact test, push, deployment, and runtime verification state.
Production changes require origin/main alignment and real entrypoint verification.

codex_cli_rule: Codex CLI uses caveman ultra by default unless explicitly disabled; code change summaries must keep changed files, verification, commit, and deploy state exact.
problem: The Saju parser accepted whole birth hours but treated 18시 37분(KST) 출생 as missing birth time, which omitted the hour pillar and contributed to an incorrect precision disclaimer.
root_cause: Numeric birth-time regex required 시 to be immediately followed by 생 or 출생.
OpenClaw completed the Saju query but then spent multiple approval waits trying to write workspace MEMORY.md, causing the combined user turn to time out.
changes: core/saju_calendar.py: parse optional birth minutes and KST or 한국 표준시 labels, validate the full time, preserve HH:MM KST in supplemental facts, and calculate the hour pillar.
core/saju_calendar.py: accept HH:MM KST birth times and deduplicate repeated identical birth or target dates while still rejecting more than two distinct dates.
tests/test_notebook_query_planning.py: cover exact 18:37 KST parsing and the 계유 hour pillar.
OpenClaw workspace MEMORY.md and daily Saju cron now use 1974-02-02 18:37 KST; cron timeout increased from 180 to 360 seconds.
